messages:
Nina: Tiny poll: whats the one office appliance youd secretly worship? Appliances only. :electric_plug:
Carlos: Microwave. I am unapologetically microwave-first. Reheats, melts cheese, saves lunch.
Bree: Im team kettle. Boil, tea, instant ramen salvation.
Sam: Microwave but only if it gets a weekly deep-clean. Otherwise the ghost of last-weeks curry haunts it.
Nina: @Sam noted. We should start a microwave spa day. 
Lunchbot: Reminder: label your containers and toss food older than 5 days. :calendar:
Carlos: Proposal: Microwave appreciation sticker on the door.
Bree: I will add a kettle hymn to the Friday playlist.
Sam: Can we have a tiny plaque: "In microwaves we trust"?
Nina: Vote so we can move forward with ceremonial recognition: Microwave, Kettle, Other.
Carlos: Microwave
Bree: Kettle
Sam: Microwave
Nina: Tally: Microwave 2, Kettle 1. Microwave wins by narrow margin. Ceremony scheduled Friday 3pm. Bring a cookie.
Lunchbot: Event added to #calendar as "Microwave Blessing".
Nina: This thread is 100% important.
